name: Frappe Framework
hook: Full-stack Python/JS framework that builds real apps with minimal code.
bullets: Metadata-driven low-code architecture — admin UI generated automatically
Full-stack: Python backend, JS frontend, MariaDB, REST API, roles, permissions
Powers ERPNext (38k+ stars) and hundreds of community apps
setupSteps: Install bench CLI: pip install frappe-bench
Initialize a new bench: bench init frappe-bench
Create a new site: bench new-site mysite.localhost
details: Frappe Framework is a full-stack, metadata-driven web framework written in Python and JavaScript. Instead of building admin panels, CRUD interfaces, forms, and permission systems from scratch, Frappe generates them automatically from DocType definitions. It includes a built-in admin UI, role-based permissions, REST API, real-time WebSocket support, and a powerful form builder. The framework has been in development since 2005 and powers ERPNext, one of the most popular open-source ERP systems with 38k+ GitHub stars. Licensed under MIT.
